Mode0 stores default; mode1 checks signed count<10 before loading, rereads count after loader returns for the variant destination, stores ID before rereading/incrementing count. Other modes do nothing.

53BCF0 resets six banks: tenFFFFFFFF variant IDs,FFFFFFFF default, zero count, then loads48 exact paths in native order (six defaults/seven variants each). Cache no callback-sensitive count/owner fields across reached loaders.

539C60 checks original filename withfopen; on failure sprintfs %c:\\%s into260 scratch using BYTE E38E62, retries, returnsFFFFFFFF if both fail. Successful initial/direct or copied fallback path is registered on selfE92BF8; always fclose the successful stream after registration.

55DD3F reads signed count/capacity and rejects only count>=capacity or null entries; native does not reject null path, negative count or failed duplication. Iterate nonnull names with case-sensitive strcmp. Append at cached initial index, store exact raw copy flag, increment fresh count, preserve normal object lifecycle and raw alias arithmetic.

560280 zeros pointer andownershipDWORDs, returns self.5602B0 frees only when ownershipDWORD andpointer are bothnonzero, then clears pointer. Preserve exceptional SEH/unwind evidence separately; no fabricated proof of host exception delivery.

55DD3F caches only the original append index: loop bounds, table pointers before each access, and count increment are reloaded around strcmp/duplication. Preserve entry/count/self aliases and callback mutations; copied-null pointers are stored and still consume a slot. Native FS-linked SEH publication/restoration and exceptional unwind must remain explicit rather than silently treating normal-return tests as exception proof.
